title: Multiparametric senescence profiling by spectral flow cytometry uncovers endothelial heterogeneity following irradiation
task: Characterize radiation-induced senescence heterogeneity in endothelial cells
key_results: Fourteen-color spectral flow cytometry panel reveals dose-dependent senescence response in human endothelial cells exposed to 0-20 Gy x-rays; higher energy (18 MV) shows deleterious effects linked to senescence markers compared to 10 MV
comments: UMAP visualization effectively captures cellular heterogeneity, but the mechanistic drivers of differential senescence responses remain incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: Human endothelial cell monolayers exposed to x-ray irradiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher energy x-rays (18 MV) induce greater senescence response than lower energy (10 MV) at equivalent doses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 18 MV shows stronger senescence-related marker elevation and deleterious effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cellular response to radiation shows dose-dependent heterogeneity among surviving endothelial cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; UMAP analysis demonstrates heterogeneous responses across all tested markers across dose range

title: Hydrogen gas alleviates osteoarthritis by inhibiting oxidative stress, apoptosis, inflammation, and extracellular matrix catabolism via the Nrf2/HO-1/NOX4 signaling pathway
task: Determine whether hydrogen gas alleviates osteoarthritis by suppressing NOX4 via Nrf2/HO-1 pathway activation to reduce oxidative stress and apoptosis
key_results: H2 reduced OARSI scores and cartilage destruction in vivo; in vitro, H2 restored chondrocyte viability, reduced ROS (8-OHdG, HNE), downregulated cleaved caspase-3/Bax while upregulating Bcl-2; H2 promoted Nrf2/HO-1 expression and suppressed NOX4
comments: Nrf2 knockdown elegantly validated Nrf2 as a crucial mediator, though the relationship between Nrf2-dependent NF-κB suppression and the Nrf2/HO-1/NOX4 axis could be better delineated.

model_io.model: Anterior cruciate ligament transection plus medial meniscus resection OA rat model
Human primary chondrocytes with IL-1β stimulation and Nrf2 modulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: H2 suppresses NOX4-derived ROS via Nrf2/HO-1 pathway activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; H2 promoted Nrf2/HO-1 expression while suppressing NOX4 both in vivo and in vitro

hypotheses.hypothesis: H2-induced Nrf2 activation is necessary and sufficient for OA protection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Nrf2 knockdown eliminated H2 protective effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: H2 reduces inflammation and apoptosis through Nrf2-dependent NF-κB suppression
hypotheses.result: Supported; Nrf2 knockdown eliminated anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic effects

title: Danshensu attenuates type 2 diabetes-related osteoporosis via the PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 signaling pathway
task: Evaluate Danshensu effects on type 2 diabetes-related osteoporosis via the PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 signaling pathway
key_results: DSS improved trabecular bone microarchitecture; in BMSCs, DSS reduced ROS/MDA, enhanced SOD/CAT activities, increased ALP activity and mineralized nodule formation with enhanced PI3K/AKT phosphorylation and Nrf2 expression
comments: Pharmacological blocking validated pathway involvement but the relative contribution of Nrf2 versus other downstream mediators remains incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: High-fat diet plus low-dose streptozotocin T2DOP mouse model
High-glucose-exposed BMSCs with PI3K/Nrf2 inhibition

hypotheses.hypothesis: DSS alleviates T2DOP through PI3K/AKT/Nrf2-mediated antioxidant responses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; blocking PI3K or Nrf2 weakened DSS protective effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: DSS preserves osteogenic differentiation capacity in high-glucose BMSCs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enhanced ALP activity, mineralized nodule formation, and osteogenic marker expression

title: Aerobic exercise induces selective changes in skeletal muscle protein quality control markers in rats with heart failure
task: Determine whether aerobic exercise preserves autophagy-lysosomal function and reduces oxidative stress in skeletal muscle during heart failure
key_results: Exercise reduced protein carbonyls (p=0.0043) and p62 expression (p=0.0449); HF induced type II fiber atrophy (type IIa: p=0.0007; type IIx/b: p<0.0001) with impaired oxidative phosphorylation complexes (p<0.05)
comments: The study acknowledges autophagic flux was not directly measured, limiting mechanistic conclusions about the autophagy-lysosomal pathway restoration.

model_io.model: Rat HF model with exercise intervention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exercise preserves autophagy-lysosomal system in HF skeletal muscle
hypotheses.result: Partial responsiveness observed; autophagy markers altered but flux not confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exercise mitigates oxidative stress in HF muscle
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; exercise reduced protein carbonyls despite HF-induced antioxidant enzyme suppression

title: Allogeneic adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells on a decellularized lung scaffold accelerate healing of experimental burn injury in rabbits
task: Evaluate therapeutic efficacy of allogeneic adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells on decellularized lung scaffolds for accelerating full-thickness burn wound healing
key_results: By day 17, ASCs-DRLS group had smaller wounds than control (0.20±0.01 vs 0.61±0.04 cm², p=0.0002); on day 14, ASCs-DRLS showed greater re-epithelialization (3.17±0.33 vs 1.33±0.33, p=0.007) and higher inflammation resolution (2.83±0.33 vs 1.50, p=0.023); enhanced collagen deposition on day 28 (3.83±0.16 vs 2.17±0.33, p=0.006)
comments: DRLS alone provided no significant benefit over control, attributing healing acceleration specifically to delivered ASCs rather than scaffold material per se.

model_io.model: Rabbit full-thickness dorsal burn wound model with cell-scaffold therapy

hypotheses.hypothesis: ASCs-DRLS accelerates burn wound healing compared to untreated control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant acceleration observed by day 17 with enhanced re-epithelialization and inflammation resolution

hypotheses.hypothesis: DRLS scaffold alone improves healing outcomes
hypotheses.result: Not confirmed; DRLS did not significantly differ from untreated control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lung-derived scaffold enhances ASC paracrine activity and tissue regeneration
hypotheses.result: Supported; therapeutic effect attributed to cells delivered on scaffold rather than scaffold alone

title: Effects of Yijing decoction on diminished ovarian reserve: associations with mitochondrial function, apoptosis, and the PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α pathway
task: Evaluate Yijing decoction effects on diminished ovarian reserve and validate the PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α signaling pathway mechanism
key_results: YJD treatment augmented ovarian weight, restored estrous cycle regularity, elevated E2 and anti-Müllerian hormone while reducing FSH/LH; upregulated PGC-1α and SIRT3 while downregulating HIF-1α in granulosa cells
comments: Network pharmacology identified 319 intersecting targets but the study acknowledges need for further functional validation of the causal role of the proposed signaling pathway.

model_io.model: Cyclophosphamide-induced DOR mouse model
Isolated granulosa cells with high glucose

hypotheses.hypothesis: YJD restores ovarian reserve function in DOR model
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ovarian weight, hormone profiles, and estrous cycles normalized

hypotheses.hypothesis: PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α pathway mediates YJD protective effects on GC mitochondrial function and apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Supported but requires further functional studies for causal validation

title: Nonlinear joint modeling of oxygenation indices for dynamic mortality prediction in neonates with persistent pulmonary hypertension receiving inhaled nitric oxide
task: Dynamic mortality prediction in neonates with PPHN using longitudinal oxygenation data
key_results: Nonlinear OSI-based joint model achieved validation AUC of 0.84, substantially outperforming linear models (AUC 0.78–0.82) and nSOFA (AUC 0.68–0.70); non-survivors showed persistently higher OSI/OI trajectories (p < 0.001)
comments: While the nonlinear joint modeling framework shows strong discriminative performance, the retrospective design and single-center cohort may limit generalizability to diverse neonatal populations.

model_io.model: Nonlinear joint model (Bayesian)
Linear joint model (comparison)
Time-varying Cox model (comparison)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic OSI/OI trajectories are associated with mortality in PPHN neonates
hypotheses.result: Non-survivors had persistently higher OSI and OI trajectories than survivors (p < 0.001)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear joint models outperform linear models and static indices for mortality prediction
hypotheses.result: Nonlinear OSI model achieved best model fit (lowest DIC/WAIC, highest LPML) and validation AUC of 0.84 versus 0.78–0.82 for linear models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Early OSI trajectories predict survival probability within 24 hours of iNO therapy
hypotheses.result: Dynamic predictions demonstrated that early OSI trajectories strongly influenced survival probability

title: Neuro-fault recognition-based cybersecurity framework for cardio-hydro-electromechanical stimulators
task: Cybersecurity of cardio-hydro-electromechanical stimulators under measurement tampering
key_results: Safety-enhanced DRL + Ni-MPC achieves 27.4% control improvement over RL-MPC and 49.8% over PI under tampering; maintains ECG tracking with constraint satisfaction.
comments: Neuro-fault recognition + bounded-policy reinforcement learning is well-motivated for safety-critical biomedical systems, though limited to simulation validation.

model_io.model: Neuro-fault identifier + Ni-MPC + Safe-DRL policy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Constraint-aware DRL improves cyber-resilience compared to unconstrained RL and classical control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: safe-DRL + Ni-MPC shows superior tracking performance and attack rejection under constraints

title: Multi-objective sustainable DER allocation in active distribution networks based on Slime Mould Algorithm
task: Multi-objective DER allocation in distribution networks via Slime Mould Algorithm
key_results: SMA-based allocation reduces active loss 71.0% (202.67→58.73 kW), reactive loss 68.3%, improves voltage stability to 0.9548, cuts emissions 42.1%, achieves 92.35% renewable penetration; outperforms PSO, DE, GA, WOA.
comments: Comprehensive multi-objective framework with statistical robustness testing (Friedman, Wilcoxon); SMA novelty for DER placement is modest but results are strong.

model_io.model: Slime Mould Algorithm (SMA) for multi-objective optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: SMA converges faster and more robustly than PSO, DE, GA, WOA on multi-objective DER placement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Friedman and Wilcoxon tests establish SMA superiority in convergence and efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupled technical-environmental objectives yield resilient active distribution networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: balanced optimization achieves high renewable penetration (92.35%) with acceptable voltage stability (0.9548)

title: Robust UAV target detection under synthetic severe weather degradations with adaptive feature propagation
task: UAV object detection under severe weather degradation
key_results: SW-DEIM achieves AP50 68.1%, AP50:95 50.0% on Drone-SW (7.9 and 6.5 pp over baseline) at 188.2 FPS; transfers to real foggy imagery (AP50 55.8%).
comments: Strong synthetic-to-real transfer on fog; however, no evaluation on naturally captured rain/snow limits claims of general real-world robustness.

model_io.model: SW-DEIM (SWVIM + AFPPN + DBB on DEIM backbone)
inputs: UAV images under rain/fog/snow degradation (synthetic and real)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive feature propagation and channel-wise residual modulation preserve detection semantics under severe weather
hypotheses.result: Supported: consistent 6–8 pp improvements over baselines; synthetic weather transfer to real fog confirmed

title: Nonlinear wave dynamics and structural response of hybrid nanocomposite open shells under aerodynamic forces on a friction-coupled elastic foundation
task: Nonlinear wave propagation in nanocomposite shells under supersonic flow
key_results: Coupled aeroelastic-foundation model predicts instability, flutter boundaries, and nonlinear dispersion characteristics unattainable by uncoupled approaches.
comments: Mathematically rigorous higher-order formulation with von Kármán nonlinearity and state-dependent aerodynamic loading; validation against FEM strengthens confidence.

model_io.model: Nonlinear coupled aeroelastic system (higher-order shear deformation + viscoelastic foundation + supersonic piston theory)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Foundation-aerodynamic coupling modifies dispersion and instability characteristics compared to uncoupled models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: coupled model reveals behaviors missed by classical piston theory

title: RCMS: a robust cybersecurity metamodel for cloud computing in Saudi Arabia
task: Cloud cybersecurity metamodel design for Saudi Arabia
key_results: RCMS defines 17 security concepts mapped to NCA ECC-1:2018 and SAMA frameworks; instantiated for banking, healthcare, energy sectors.
comments: Metamodel is theoretically comprehensive but lacks empirical validation—no measured deployments or independent scalability/reusability assessments reported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cloud-specific, localized cybersecurity frameworks improve alignment with national regulatory obligations
hypotheses.result: Supported by design: RCMS incorporates Vision 2030 alignment and regulatory constraints, though deployment validation pending

title: Digital literacy shapes AI chatbot adoption, barriers, and performance outcomes in football coaches: a multi-method analytical study
task: Digital literacy as mediator of AI chatbot adoption among football coaches
key_results: Digital literacy fully mediates age-adoption effect (ab = −0.31); adoption threshold at 4.5/7 (28%→78% probability, χ²=48.7, p<0.001); 'AI Value Chain' cluster (10%) reports >3 hrs/week savings.
comments: Rigorous mediation analysis and ROC thresholding; cluster finding is actionable but sample size (n=213) and coach-specific context limits generalization.

model_io.model: Mediation model + ROC curve + cluster analysis (k-means)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital literacy (not age/experience) is the primary driver of adoption and adoption barriers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: literacy mediates age effect; cultural barrier among experienced coaches explained by literacy gap

hypotheses.hypothesis: A critical competency threshold exists above which adoption probability sharply increases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 4.5/7 threshold demarcates 28% vs. 78% adoption probability

title: Troll detection using generative adversarial network (GAN) based on social network features
task: Troll detection via behavioral change in social networks
key_results: TrollGAN achieves higher accuracy and F1-score than LSTM and logistic regression on Twitter datasets (14.9K labeled + 3M Russian tweets); maintains stable performance at scale.
comments: Semi-supervised GAN with LSTM integration is reasonable, but paper lacks detailed ablation studies and comparison with recent transformer-based detection methods.

model_io.model: TrollGAN (Generator + Discriminator + Classifier + LSTM)

hypotheses.hypothesis: GANs with relational social network features enable better behavioral change detection than single-task models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TrollGAN outperforms baselines in accuracy, F1-score, and generalization

title: Inert gas atmospheric pressure plasma post-processing of fused silica micro-lenses produced by means of femtosecond laser-induced chemical etching
task: Post-process femtosecond laser-etched fused silica micro-lenses using atmospheric pressure plasma polishing
key_results: Surface roughness reduced from Ra = 0.207 ± 0.044 µm to 0.047 ± 0.018 µm (>75% reduction); optimal parameters: 5 mm gap, 5.5 W power; >90% efficiency maintained
comments: Effective roughness reduction with geometry preservation is demonstrated, but scalability to large batches and cost-benefit versus alternative polishing methods warrants further analysis.

model_io.model: Atmospheric pressure plasma polishing system

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stable plasma discharge with high electric field strength at optimized gap and power yields maximum polishing efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—5 mm gap and 5.5 W produced stable discharge and highest efficiency; higher values caused instability and inhomogeneity

title: Design of a novel filtering antenna using waveguide with enhanced stopband attenuation
task: Design compact filtering antenna combining filtering and radiation in rectangular waveguide for satellite/radar systems
key_results: Inline filtenna: 1.02 GHz filtering bandwidth, 7.05 dBi gain, reflection <-19 dB; rotated-offset: 0.5 GHz radiation bandwidth, 6.15 dBi gain; both >90% efficiency
comments: Integration of filtering and radiation in one element is elegant, but the trade-off between filtering selectivity and radiation bandwidth across designs suggests application-specific optimization is needed.

model_io.model: Rectangular waveguide filtenna (WR-90) with two metallic posts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-post metallic design enables independent control of transmission zeros and quality factor without coupling irises
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—both configurations achieved high stopband attenuation and >90% efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotated-offset configuration extends radiation bandwidth compared to inline design
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—rotated-offset: 0.5 GHz vs. inline: 0.20 GHz radiation bandwidth
